caption:
Figure 3. Illustration of our proposed PlanarSplatting. Given a set of posed multi-view images of indoor scenes, our method renders
depth and normal maps from 3D plane primitives. Then, with the supervision of monocular cues, these 3D plane primitives are gradually
optimized to recover the scene geometry and finally merged to get the planar reconstruction result.
